newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Aboitiz raises Republic Cement stake.
newsitem.headline: Aboitiz raises Republic Cement stake.

text.p: Aboitiz Equity Ventures said on Monday it had bought a block of 37.115 million shares or 4.9 percent of Republic Cement Corp.
Aboitiz said in a statement that the shares were bought from the Government Service Insurance System (GSIS). The amount of the purchase was not disclosed.
The additional shares bring the total stake of Aboitiz in the cement company to about 18.5 percent from a previous stake of nearly 14 percent, the statement said.
Aboitiz said it had been building up its stake in Republic Cement for the last two years.
